description: Observed current MET Norway / Avinor METAR temperature, CC BY 4.0 and NLOD 2.0. London uses EGLC, Karachi OPKC and Tokyo RJTT. These are named airport observations, not city-centre interpolation or forecasts. Exact station and observation times are checked. Both temperature_c and temp_c carry the same Celsius reading.
